en.description:
A FULL SURVIVAL GAME, ON YOUR WRIST

WatchBlocks is a native sandbox survival game built from the ground up for Apple Watch. This isn't a companion app or a mini-game. It's the complete experience: mine deep caves, craft tools and gear, build anything you can imagine, farm your own food, battle bosses, tame companions, and explore six procedurally generated biomes, all from your wrist.

And it doesn't stop at the watch. WatchBlocks also runs on all your devices, with cross-device multiplayer and worlds that travel with you. Start a world on your watch during the day, keep building on your iPhone at night.

EXPLORE SIX PROCEDURAL BIOMES
Every world is generated fresh, with distinct biomes to discover, each with its own blocks, resources, and secrets. No two adventures play out the same way.

SURVIVE OR CREATE
Survival mode: gather, craft, eat, and defend yourself when night falls and the bosses come out. Creative mode: unlimited resources, total freedom, pure building.

PLAY TOGETHER
Team up with friends in cross-device multiplayer. Your worlds live in the cloud and follow you across every device you own.

MAKE IT YOURS
Build custom worlds, design your own character skins, and create full mods with the built-in mod tools. Then share your creations with the community.

NEW IN VERSION 1.7
- Community Worlds: publish your own worlds and explore creations from players around the world
- Pocket Realm: worlds inside worlds, a whole new layer to build in
- New furniture and decorative blocks, including chairs and tables

FAIR PRICING, NO NONSENSE
Free to download with a 3-day trial of the complete game. Full Access is a $4.99 one-time purchase that unlocks everything: saved worlds, Creative mode, custom worlds and skins, mod creation, and more. No ads. No subscription. No pay-to-win. Ever.

Contact Us: formidablegamesstudio@gmail.com
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://formidable-studio.com#privacy
en.releaseNotes:
WatchBlocks v1.7 Spooky Hollow:
* New Biome: The Mystlands, a new vibrant spooky biome with fog and mushroom trees
* Pocket Realm: A new item which can allow you to create a new world inside your world to let you keep exploring
* Apple Watch multiplayer improved: two Apple Watches can now play together without another device
* Community Worlds: you can now share your worlds for everyone to see
* 5 new mobs: bats, shroomlings, zombies, witches, and ghosts
* You can now create small, medium, or large worlds, along with existing infinite worlds
* Creative mode in 3D is now available for full access users
* For Apple Watch, made movement better for 3D
* 3D is a lot faster now
* New cosmetics, including a halloween pack, and pets
* New weapon: The Dagger, has a special dash attack
* Furnace: A new block you can use to cook food or make glass. This can be upgraded to fit more fuel and items to cook/smelt
* New meat types from different mobs like pork, beef, and fish
* Brain, a new food type item you can eat and turns you into a zombie
* Enchanted Berries, give you a speed boost for limited time when eaten
* Potion brewing: Make a cauldron and make 13 different potions with unique abilities. Either drink or splash
* Brand new achievements
* Leaderboards can now be viewed on Apple Watch
* New blocks and items include pumpkins, candles, tables, chairs, mushrooms, mushroom blocks, crystals, and more
* Cloud Runner can now be upgraded
* Biome ambience improved
* Want to try your world in a new way? Duplicate it so you don’t ruin anything
* Pulse laser retextured and has a new crafting recipe
* UI polish
* Controller gets more support, allowing more such as mod creation
* App Icons are moved to Customization tab, and new ones have been added
* If your GameCenter username hasn’t been added, you’ll be given a random username which can be modified in settings 
* Fixed a bug where your language wouldn’t use your primary language

ja.description:
手首で遊べる、本格サバイバルゲーム

WatchBlocksは、Apple Watch向けに一から開発したサンドボックス型サバイバルゲームです。コンパニオンアプリでもミニゲームでもありません。完全なゲーム体験です。深い洞窟を探検し、道具や装備を作り、思いのままに建築し、食料を育て、ボスと戦い、仲間を手なずけ、6つの自動生成バイオームを手首の上で冒険しましょう。

冒険はApple Watchだけにとどまりません。WatchBlocksはお使いのほかのデバイスでも遊べ、デバイスをまたいだマルチプレイや、どこへでも持ち運べるワールドに対応しています。日中はApple Watchでワールドを始め、夜はiPhoneで建築を続けましょう。

6つの自動生成バイオームを探検

ワールドは毎回新しく生成され、それぞれ異なるバイオーム、ブロック、資源、秘密が待っています。同じ冒険は二度とありません。

サバイバルか、クリエイティブか

サバイバルモードでは、資源を集め、道具を作り、食料を確保し、夜が訪れてボスが現れたら身を守ります。クリエイティブモードでは、資源は無制限。自由に、思うままに建築できます。

一緒にプレイ

デバイスをまたいだマルチプレイで友達と協力しましょう。ワールドはクラウドに保存され、どのデバイスからでも続けられます。

自分だけの世界に

カスタムワールドを作り、キャラクターのスキンをデザインし、内蔵ツールで本格的なModを作成できます。作品をコミュニティで共有しましょう。

バージョン1.7の新要素

- コミュニティワールド：自分のワールドを公開し、世界中のプレイヤーの作品を探検
- Pocket Realm：ワールドの中にワールドを作り、新たな空間で建築
- 椅子やテーブルなど、新しい家具と装飾ブロック

わかりやすい価格、余計なものなし

無料でダウンロードでき、ゲーム全体を3日間お試しいただけます。フルアクセスは一度の購入で、保存ワールド、クリエイティブモード、カスタムワールドとスキン、Mod作成などすべてを解放します。広告なし。サブスクリプションなし。課金で有利になることもありません。今後も同じです。

お問い合わせ: formidablegamesstudio@gmail.com

利用規約: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

プライバシーポリシー: https://formidable-studio.com#privacy

de.description:
EIN VOLLSTÄNDIGES SURVIVAL-SPIEL AM HANDGELENK

WatchBlocks ist ein Sandbox-Survival-Spiel, das von Grund auf für die Apple Watch entwickelt wurde. Keine Begleit-App und kein Minispiel, sondern das volle Erlebnis: Erkunde tiefe Höhlen, stelle Werkzeuge und Ausrüstung her, baue, was immer du dir vorstellst, bewirtschafte deine Felder, kämpfe gegen Bosse, zähme Gefährten und entdecke sechs prozedural erzeugte Biome – alles direkt am Handgelenk.

Und es bleibt nicht bei der Watch. WatchBlocks läuft auch auf all deinen Geräten, mit geräteübergreifendem Mehrspieler und Welten, die dich begleiten. Starte tagsüber eine Welt auf deiner Watch und baue nachts auf dem iPhone weiter.

SECHS PROZEDURALE BIOME ENTDECKEN

Jede Welt wird neu generiert und bietet eigene Biome mit besonderen Blöcken, Rohstoffen und Geheimnissen. Kein Abenteuer gleicht dem anderen.

ÜBERLEBEN ODER ERSCHAFFEN

Überlebensmodus: Sammle, stelle Dinge her, iss und verteidige dich, wenn es Nacht wird und Bosse auftauchen. Kreativmodus: unbegrenzte Ressourcen, völlige Freiheit, grenzenloses Bauen.

ZUSAMMEN SPIELEN

Spiele mit Freunden im geräteübergreifenden Mehrspieler. Deine Welten liegen in der Cloud und sind auf jedem deiner Geräte verfügbar.

GESTALTE DEIN SPIEL

Erstelle eigene Welten, entwirf Charakter-Skins und baue mit den integrierten Modding-Werkzeugen vollständige Mods. Teile deine Kreationen anschließend mit der Community.

NEU IN VERSION 1.7

- Community-Welten: Veröffentliche eigene Welten und entdecke Kreationen von Spielern aus aller Welt
- Pocket Realm: Welten in Welten, eine ganz neue Ebene zum Bauen
- Neue Möbel und Deko-Blöcke, darunter Stühle und Tische

FAIRE PREISE, KEIN KLEINGEDRUCKTES

Kostenloser Download mit einer 3-tägigen Testphase des vollständigen Spiels. Der Vollzugriff ist ein einmaliger Kauf und schaltet alles frei: gespeicherte Welten, Kreativmodus, eigene Welten und Skins, Mod-Erstellung und mehr. Keine Werbung. Kein Abo. Kein Pay-to-win. Niemals.

Kontakt: formidablegamesstudio@gmail.com

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Datenschutz: https://formidable-studio.com#privacy

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Fixed bugs
Fixed bugs
Bug fixes, and iPad support

What's new in v1.1:

- Cotton: a new plant found in grasslands. Gives you cotton when you break, currently no use for it
- Ruined towers: Spawn randomly, contain chests at the top
- Auto break trees: when you get close to a tree, you will start to break it. Makes navigating your world easier. Toggle available for this
- Multiplayer with iPhone and Apple Watch is now clearly shown, not available for iPad
- Days last 5 minutes, nights last 2 minutes instead of the previous 2 minute days
- Option to disable haptics
- Plenty of bug fixes

New Features and Content

World Generation and Balance

* Reduced cotton spawn rate and removed it from spawning inside trees

Performance

What’s New in WatchBlocks

New Features

* Chickens added
* Partial controller support added
* Sound effects and audio added
* Original music by Hunter Shoemaker added
* FPS counter added

Fixes & Changes

WatchBlocks v1.5.7 - The Launcher Update
* Added the Launcher, which can launch eggs, snowballs, diamonds, TNT, and turtle shells
* Eggs deal 1 damage on direct hits
* Snowballs no longer deal damage, but now hit more directly and briefly slow mobs
* Diamonds instantly defeat mobs on impact
* TNT explodes when it hits a block or mob
* Turtle shells deal 1 damage on impact, bounce back and forth for 15 seconds, then disappear

What else is new:
* Improved the hotbar: scroll horizontally through up to 10 items on smaller screens (even Apple Watch!)
* Free users can now switch between different skins. Creating custom skins still requires Full Access
* Clouds now show up in the background
* Skins have new looks to match more with the world
* Skeletons have a new look to match more with the world
* Added new achievements and updated collections
* Removed CraftBits, all community mods are now free
* Changed momentum physics
* Fixed an issue preventing some flowers from generating
* Reduced sound delays

WatchBlocks v1.5.8
- Fixed some collection bugs
- Fixed slime launched
- Fixed background issue

WatchBlocks v1.5.9 - The Cloudreach
* Cloudreach Biome: A new biome high above the clouds. Staying up there too long can freeze you; wear some armor to help protect you
* Cloud Blocks: These make up the new Cloudreach Biome
* 2 new mobs: Cloudling (friendly) and Storm Wisp (hostile)
* Thunderbolt: Dropped from Storm Wisp, and can be launched with the launcher item
* Cloudrunner: A new vehicular item you can use to traverse your world
* New weapon: Boomerang. Throw it at enemies, and it comes right back
* 5 new languages supported: Spanish, German, French, Japanese, and Chinese (Simplified). More languages to come in the future
* Full access now grants the ability to create 3D worlds, a new early access feature
* Mod creator has expanded with new options to make mods
* Visual improvements in world creation and mod creation UI
* Brand new looks on the horizon and in the background
* A lot better performance
* Enjoy new stickers to use in Messages

WatchBlocks v1.6.1: Small But Meaningful

* Creative mode is now available for free players, though cannot save a creative world
* At night, no music plays, just the wind
* Improved some of the icons across the game
* Controller support improved
* 3D is smoother and can render further
* Added a color saturation slider for those who want their game more or less saturated
* You can now split stacks in your inventory
* Cloud runner is fixed and works as intended
* Fixed hotbar issue when scrolling

WatchBlocks v1.6.2: Filling in the Gaps

* New skins for full access users

* Glow sword and glow pickaxe have been added
* Gold sword, pickaxe, and armor have been added

* Redesigned health bar that’s more compact
* Hunger bar: To survive, you must eat food. If you do not, you will slowly lose damage. You can turn this off in world settings if needed.

* Auto accept anyone in multiplayer by default

* Player no longer places blocks when attacking a mob

WatchBlocks v1.6.3: Sharks & Minnows
* Added Sharks and Fish mobs
* Rain and thunder storms
* UI changes
* New customization option: trails. For now only one for full access players
* New UI theme option for sharks update

WatchBlocks v1.7 Spooky Hollow:
* New Biome: The Mystlands, a new vibrant spooky biome with fog and mushroom trees
* Pocket Realm: A new item which can allow you to create a new world inside your world to let you keep exploring
* Apple Watch multiplayer improved: two Apple Watches can now play together without another device
* Community Worlds: you can now share your worlds for everyone to see
* 5 new mobs: bats, shroomlings, zombies, witches, and ghosts
* You can now create small, medium, or large worlds, along with existing infinite worlds
* Creative mode in 3D is now available for full access users
* For Apple Watch, made movement better for 3D
* 3D is a lot faster now
* New cosmetics, including a halloween pack, and pets
* New weapon: The Dagger, has a special dash attack
* Furnace: A new block you can use to cook food or make glass. This can be upgraded to fit more fuel and items to cook/smelt
* New meat types from different mobs like pork, beef, and fish
* Brain, a new food type item you can eat and turns you into a zombie
* Enchanted Berries, give you a speed boost for limited time when eaten
* Potion brewing: Make a cauldron and make 13 different potions with unique abilities. Either drink or splash
* Brand new achievements
* Leaderboards can now be viewed on Apple Watch
* New blocks and items include pumpkins, candles, tables, chairs, mushrooms, mushroom blocks, crystals, and more
* Cloud Runner can now be upgraded
* Biome ambience improved
* Want to try your world in a new way? Duplicate it so you don’t ruin anything
* Pulse laser retextured and has a new crafting recipe
* UI polish
* Controller gets more support, allowing more such as mod creation
* App Icons are moved to Customization tab, and new ones have been added
* If your GameCenter username hasn’t been added, you’ll be given a random username which can be modified in settings 
* Fixed a bug where your language wouldn’t use your primary language
